Overview.Name: Rachakonda Samatha
Overview.Goal: Prevent and reverse health issues while supporting hormonal balance.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Brunch_or_Main_Meal: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + curd + vegetable curry
Meal_2_Light_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 2: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable curry + small portion plain rice + curd

Notes_and_Tips: Since meals per day are limited, avoid skipping the main meal.
Keep rice portions small to support thyroid and PCOS management.
Avoid frequent fried and very spicy foods as preferred.
Eat slowly and stop when comfortably full.
Regular yoga and consistent meal timing support hormonal balance.
Focus on health improvements and energy rather than quick weight loss.
